description: This file defines the PayrollPeriod class and related functions for handling payroll periods, including validation, overlap checking, and period calculations within the ERPNext payroll module.

classes.name: PayrollPeriod
classes.description: Represents a payroll period with validation and overlap checking.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the payroll period dates and checks for overlaps.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Ensures start_date is not after end_date.

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping payroll periods within the same company.
